# Back-to-School Health Checklist: Getting Kids Ready for the New School Year


‍


Transitioning from relaxed summer days to structured school mornings is always a balancing act for Mt. Hood families. Between shopping for school supplies and adjusting bedtime routines, routine healthcare visits can easily slip through the cracks. However, scheduling early health checks gives kids a grounded, confident start to the school year.


‍


At Orchid Health Hoodland Clinic, we take pride in providing compassionate, local healthcare to families throughout Welches, Brightwood, Rhododendron, and the surrounding Hoodland corridor. Having a primary care provider right in your neighborhood—someone who truly knows your child—makes a world of difference for their ongoing wellness.


**Why Early Back-to-School Checkups Matter**


Rather than waiting until a bug goes around the classroom, an annual checkup allows our medical team to track growth milestones, evaluate vision and hearing, and update health plans before minor issues impact learning. Because we offer same-day appointments, fitting high-quality local healthcare into your busy family calendar is easy.


Our local pediatric and family care services include:


- **Well-Child Exams & Routine Checkups:** Comprehensive pediatric care to ensure your child is thriving physically and developmentally.
- **Sports Physicals:** Thorough physical exams so your student-athletes can safely participate in fall sports for the Oregon Trail School District.
- **Urgent & Acute Care:** Fast treatment for seasonal sniffles, sore throats, coughs, or playground scrapes—saving you from driving down the mountain for quality medical care. Telehealth options are also available for added convenience.
- **Integrated Behavioral Health:** Returning to school can bring social stress and anxiety. Our behavioral health specialists offer short-term counseling to help students build coping skills, form healthy habits, and navigate school dynamics.


**Accessible, Affordable Care for Oregon Trail School District Families**


Healthcare shouldn't be a financial burden. Through our School-Based Health Center (SBHC) partnership with the Oregon Trail School District, local K-12 students can access essential care with no out-of-pocket costs. Whether your child needs a quick strep swab, a sports physical, or a mental health check-in, expert care is available right down the road.


**Visit Your Local Welches Health Clinic**


Skip the long drive into Sandy or Gresham and get personalized care right here in the Hoodland area.


- **Location:** 24461 E Welches Rd, Welches, OR 97067 (conveniently located right next to the post office)
- **Hours:** Monday – Friday: 8:30 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.
- **Contact:** Call us at **(971) 333-0494** or stop by to schedule your child’s back-to-school wellness exam or sports physical today.
